tables.name: resorts
tables.description: One row per ski resort on the index, with the SNOTEL station or stations that stand in for it. A station is a proxy: it is near the resort, not the resort's own stake.

columns.name: resort_id
columns.description: Stable slug, for example 'alta' or 'park-city'. Primary key.

columns.name: resort_name
columns.description: Display name, for example 'Alta' or 'Park City Mountain'.

columns.name: area
columns.description: Canyon or range the resort sits in, for example 'Little Cottonwood Canyon'.

columns.name: latitude
columns.description: Latitude of the base area, decimal degrees.

columns.name: longitude
columns.description: Longitude of the base area, decimal degrees (negative: west).

columns.name: base_elev_ft
columns.description: Published base elevation in feet.

columns.name: summit_elev_ft
columns.description: Published summit elevation in feet.

columns.name: station_names
columns.description: SNOTEL station or stations used for this resort, heaviest weight first.

columns.name: station_count
columns.description: Number of stations blended for this resort (1 or 2).

columns.name: nearest_station_km
columns.description: Distance from the resort base to its nearest station, kilometers.

columns.name: station_elev_ft
columns.description: Weighted elevation of the stations in feet.

columns.name: proxy_quality
columns.description: How close the stations are: 'on_mountain' (within 3 km), 'nearby' (within 8 km), or 'regional' (farther; treat the numbers as a regional signal).

tables.name: resort_daily
tables.description: The morning snow report: one row per resort per day, from September of the previous season to the latest reading. Values dated D describe 00:00 on D and the hours before it, so new_snow_24h_in on D fell during calendar day D-1. New snow is settled snow measured at a station near the resort and reads lower than a resort's own total.

columns.name: resort_id
columns.description: Resort slug. Joins to resorts.resort_id and powder_score.resort_id.

columns.name: resort_name
columns.description: Display name of the resort.

columns.name: date
columns.description: Report date (DATE). The reading was taken at 00:00 that morning.

columns.name: water_year
columns.description: Season label (INTEGER). A water year runs 1 October to 30 September and is named for the year it ends in, so winter 2025-26 is water year 2026.

columns.name: snow_depth_in
columns.description: Snow on the ground, inches.

columns.name: swe_in
columns.description: Snow water equivalent, inches of water held in the snowpack.

columns.name: new_snow_24h_in
columns.description: Estimated new snow in the 24 hours before the reading, inches.

columns.name: new_snow_72h_in
columns.description: Estimated new snow over the last 3 days (72 hours), inches.

columns.name: new_snow_7d_in
columns.description: Estimated new snow over the last 7 days, inches.

columns.name: season_snowfall_in
columns.description: Running total of new snow since 1 October of the row's water year, inches.

columns.name: days_since_snow
columns.description: Days since the last day with at least 1 inch of new snow. 0 on a snow day. Null before the first snowfall in the data.

columns.name: swe_gain_24h_in
columns.description: Increase in snow water equivalent over the last 24 hours, inches of water (0 if it fell).

columns.name: density_24h_pct
columns.description: Water content of the last 24 hours of new snow, percent (water that fell as snow / new snow x 100, at most 20). Lower is lighter. Null when less than 1 inch fell.

columns.name: density_72h_pct
columns.description: Water content of the last 72 hours of new snow, percent. Lower is lighter powder. Null when less than 1 inch fell.

columns.name: temp_obs_f
columns.description: Air temperature at the midnight reading, degrees F.

columns.name: temp_avg_24h_f
columns.description: Mean air temperature over the previous calendar day, degrees F.

columns.name: temp_min_24h_f
columns.description: Lowest air temperature over the previous calendar day, degrees F.

columns.name: temp_max_24h_f
columns.description: Highest air temperature over the previous calendar day, degrees F.

columns.name: temp_avg_72h_f
columns.description: Mean air temperature over the previous 3 days, degrees F.

columns.name: forecast_snow_72h_in
columns.description: National Weather Service snowfall forecast for the next 72 hours, inches. Only filled on the day the pipeline ran (the latest date); null on every earlier date.

columns.name: forecast_snow_day_1_in
columns.description: Forecast snowfall for hours 0 to 24, inches. Null except on the latest date.

columns.name: forecast_snow_day_2_in
columns.description: Forecast snowfall for hours 24 to 48, inches. Null except on the latest date.

columns.name: forecast_snow_day_3_in
columns.description: Forecast snowfall for hours 48 to 72, inches. Null except on the latest date.

columns.name: forecast_precip_72h_in
columns.description: Forecast liquid precipitation for the next 72 hours, inches. Null except on the latest date.

columns.name: forecast_temp_min_72h_f
columns.description: Lowest forecast air temperature over the next 72 hours, degrees F. Null except on the latest date.

columns.name: has_missing_reading
columns.description: True when a station reading was missing that day and the last value was carried forward.

tables.name: powder_score
tables.description: The powder score, 0 to 100, one row per resort per day, with its six components. score = 100 x sum(weight x component) / sum(weights of known components). Each component is a 0-to-1 ramp between two anchors; weights and anchors live in the powder_score_weights seed. The *_points columns add up to powder_score exactly. The forecast component is null on replayed days, where the other weights are rescaled.

columns.name: resort_id
columns.description: Resort slug. Joins to resorts.resort_id and resort_daily.resort_id.

columns.name: resort_name
columns.description: Display name of the resort.

columns.name: date
columns.description: Report date (DATE). Joins to resort_daily.date.

columns.name: water_year
columns.description: Season label (INTEGER), named for the year the season ends in: winter 2025-26 is water year 2026.

columns.name: powder_score
columns.description: Powder score from 0 (nothing to ski) to 100 (deep, light, cold, and more coming).

columns.name: tier
columns.description: Label for the score: 'epic' (75+), 'powder' (55+), 'soft' (35+), 'firm' (15+), 'off' (below 15).

columns.name: rank
columns.description: Rank among all resorts on that date, 1 = best. Ties break on 72-hour snow, then depth, then name.

columns.name: fresh_24h_score
columns.description: New snow in the last 24 hours as a 0-to-1 score (1 at 12 inches or more).

columns.name: fresh_72h_score
columns.description: New snow in the last 72 hours as a 0-to-1 score (1 at 24 inches or more).

columns.name: density_score
columns.description: Lightness of the storm snow as a 0-to-1 score (1 at 8% water or less, 0 at 18% or more), scaled down when under 6 inches fell in 72 hours.

columns.name: cold_score
columns.description: Cold preservation as a 0-to-1 score (1 at a 72-hour mean of 18 F or colder, 0 at 36 F or warmer, 0 on bare ground).

columns.name: base_score
columns.description: Snow depth as a 0-to-1 score (1 at 60 inches or more).

columns.name: forecast_score
columns.description: Forecast snowfall for the next 72 hours as a 0-to-1 score (1 at 12 inches or more). Null when there is no forecast for the date.

columns.name: fresh_24h_points
columns.description: Points the 24-hour snow contributes to powder_score.

columns.name: fresh_72h_points
columns.description: Points the 72-hour snow contributes to powder_score.

columns.name: density_points
columns.description: Points snow density contributes to powder_score.

columns.name: cold_points
columns.description: Points cold preservation contributes to powder_score.

columns.name: base_points
columns.description: Points base depth contributes to powder_score.

columns.name: forecast_points
columns.description: Points the forecast contributes to powder_score. Null when there is no forecast for the date.

columns.name: weight_known
columns.description: Sum of the weights of the components that were known that day (1.0 with a forecast, 0.9 without).
